card.name: Words before era, society or world nouns
card.fires_on: Small words such as our, we, of, this, global or intense that come just before a noun for an era, society, world or planet in general web essays. The next word is often something like world, society, times or culture.

modes.label: Our / this before world or society
modes.description: Possessive or demonstrative word before a noun for the world, planet or society.
modes.example: limited resources of<< our>> planet. In this framework, economic growth

modes.label: Adjective before era or culture
modes.description: Adjective that sets up a description of present-day conditions or a culture.
modes.example: During these times of<< intense>> competition for research funding

modes.label: Generation or era phrase
modes.description: Linking word in phrases about a generation or period.

card.writes: It suppresses trend and era words like trends and 趋势 and slightly favors habit and lifestyle words.
card.plain: It fires on small words that lead into talk about our world, our times or society as a whole.
